reviewer: Astra independent texas ECE membership audit
independence: Only neutral person_id, name, profile_url and original_title read from parent roster. Existing category/included/decision fields not inspected. Official directory pages freshly fetched. Previously fetched immutable official core profiles reused with SHA256; no parent snapshots modified.
policy: Current official department/core ECE membership plus regular research professor role. Genuine ECE/CS joint appointments retained. Explicit courtesy, affiliate-only, adjunct, teaching/instruction, practice, research-only, emeritus and retired roles kept separate. Endowed teaching fellowships and past appointments do not determine current role.

coverage.scope_completeness: All supplied neutral records exactly match the official all-directory set; every record is classified against explicit official category membership. Core regular candidates have individual official profile evidence.
coverage.completeness_limit: All-directory pages omit some entries that remain on emeritus/retired category pages. These additional excluded-category names are recorded for transparency; no additional current regular ECE entries found. Website-defined current count, not HR census.
